findings.title: Late-fee rounding mode changed — customers may be overcharged
findings.summary: The proposed change switches MoneyUtils.roundLateFee() from RoundingMode.DOWN to RoundingMode.HALF_UP. This silently alters the rounding behaviour for all late fees in the billing cycle.
findings.business_impact: Customers will be charged up to $0.01 more per late fee whenever the third decimal digit of (outstandingBalance × 0.00823) is ≥ 5. At scale across all accounts in a billing cycle this is a systematic overcharge that is not visible in any existing test.

evidence.excerpt:
-        return value.setScale(2, RoundingMode.DOWN);
+        return value.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
// balance=1000.00, rate=0.00823 → raw fee=8.230 → DOWN=8.23, HALF_UP=8.23 (same result at this value — test does not catch the regression)

findings.recommended_action: Revert the rounding mode change in MoneyUtils.roundLateFee() to RoundingMode.DOWN. Add a characterization test using a balance where the third decimal of (balance × 0.00823) is ≥ 5 (e.g. balance=1234.56) to detect future regressions.
